name: The Great Lump
text: On a Nest, this also has half its Bird's current stats.
golden_text: On a Nest, this also has its Bird's full current stats.
details: Rounds each stat up, before Egg auras. Loses the borrowed stats when its Bird comes home.
golden_details: Borrows twice as much: its Bird's full stats, before Egg auras. Loses them when its Bird comes home.
